question: When US estate agents sold their own homes rather than their clients', what changed?
answer: They sold slower, for more: about 3.7% higher prices, after about ten more days on the market. On a client's house, an extra $10,000 might earn the agent around $150 for weeks of extra work, so a quick sale suits them. On their own house, they keep it all, and wait.
move: Work out how much of the extra gain your adviser actually keeps.
ask: Who advises me on big decisions, and how much do they gain from my best outcome?
trap: Assuming a commission makes the agent want what the seller wants.
reference: Levitt & Syverson, Market Distortions When Agents Are Better Informed: The Value of Information in Real Estate Transactions, Review of Economics and Statistics, 2008
